name: triage_reader
description: Reads one Triage item: what it is, what each source answered, every source it could not check and why, the files it points at, and a fix hint. Reads only; never acts or writes outside its result.

context.description: From triage_read, as JSON: the item, its reports (each with its door and words), and the sources this Lemma has (sources, with connected).

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences on what this is and what it rests on. Every claim comes from an evidence line.

source.description: Where you looked: Sentry, PostHog, GitHub, CODEOWNERS, Reports, Open issues, Slack, Code, Logs, ...

asked.description: The question you put to it, short: 'Who hits it, since when?'

answer.description: What it answered, one line with its figures; for a source you could not check, why ('No logs source is connected').

url.description: A link to what you read, when there is one.

paths.description: Files it points at, the most likely first, as path or path:line.

fix_hint.description: One line on where a fix would go, or empty when you can't tell.
